mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_message (session_id, role, content, tokens, skill_used, model_used, run_id, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{tokens}, #{skillUsed}, #{modelUsed}, #{runId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_message SET session_id = #{sessionId}, role = #{role}, content = #{content}, tokens = #{tokens}, skill_used = #{skillUsed}, model_used = #{modelUsed}, run_id = #{runId}, created_at = #{createdAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conversation_message WHERE id = #{id})
